tennavapallarāyara: [Yadicchānāma] (pu) CL=7 (Damiḷa- Chief) named Tennavaṃpallarāyara. See original.
tettisa: [Ti+tiṃsa.(trayaotiṃgata-saṃ)] (thī) CL=7 Thirty-three , 33 persons. Tettiṃsa(ti) [tettiṃsa+ḍa=a.(trayaotiṃga-saṃ)] It reaches to thirty three (or) It is serial number thirty three, It is 33rd. Tettiṃsa(ti) [tettiṃsa+ṇa] A place where is being 33 persons who are partner of doing wholesome deeds. See - Tāvatiṃsa.
tettisakumbha: [Tettiṃsa(1)+kumbha] (pu) CL=7 There is 33 numbers of (Elephant"s) heads.
tettisamanussaseṭṭha: [Tettiṃsa+manussa+seṭṭha] (pu) CL=7 (Magha young man) who is noble among 33 people.
tettisapiṇḍa: [Tettiṃsa+piḍa] (pu) CL=7 There is 33 lumps of (cooked) rice.
tettisatima: [Tettiṃsati+ma.(trayaotiṃga-saṃ)] (ti) CL=7 It is the cause of fulfill to 33rd, (Sutta etc.,) which 33rd sutta.
tettisaṅgula: [Tettiṃsa(1)+aṅgula] (ti) CL=7 It is 33 finger-breadths. (Four edged dagger etc.,) which is 33 finger-breadths length.
tettisaṅgulāyata: [Tettiṃsaṅgula+āyata] (ti) CL=7 (Four edged dagger etc.,) which is 33 finger-breadths length.
